diagram_math_checks.result: The local definition identifies E_{a,b}=[Rep_Q(a,b)/P_{a,b}] and explicitly defines q to M_a x M_b by subrepresentation and quotient. With 0 -> A -> E -> B -> 0, A has dimension a and B has dimension b; the left arrow originates at E_{a,b}, with no reversed order.

The local definition defines p by forgetting the subrepresentation, with codomain M_{a+b}; dimensions in the caption are a, a+b, b for A,E,B. Both arrows are morphisms of the existing stacks, with no map from one endpoint stack to the other and no asserted commutative relation.

Proof 1.1 gives off-diagonal parameters C_h in Hom(V_i^b,V_j^a), e=sum_{h:i->j} b_i a_j, and changes of splitting U of dimension u=sum_i a_i b_i. Proof 2.1 identifies the target-atlas pullback with [Y/U] -> Z, not an affine extension-class space, and establishes relative stack dimension e-u=-chi_Q(b,a). The caption uses exactly that sign and argument order.

Proof 1.2 identifies the scheme base change over a family (E_i,X_h) with the closed incidence locus in product_i Gr_T(a_i,E_i), imposing F_i -> E_j/F_j zero for every h:i->j. Proof 3.1 concludes representable proper. No claim that q is representable or that p has constant fibre dimension is added.
The four original numbered proof steps remain byte-identical, before the final Remarks. The figure is explanatory and supplies no proof premise.
